name: Phantom Train
description: Sacrifice another creature or artifact: Put a +1/+1 counter on this Vehicle. It becomes an artifact creature until end of turn. It's a Spirit in addition to its other types until end of turn.
assumptions: Merged 1.2 (becomes, cond:type=artifact-creature) and 1.3 (tagger, cond:tag=Spirit) into one "until end of turn" sentence, since both share lifetime:turn and if:1.0.
Read the two unlettered 1.0 sink lines as one disjunctive sacrifice cost ("another creature or artifact"), per the unlettered-step-sharing convention.
Assumed the activated ability has no mana component, since cost: is only ever stated on cast lines.
couldNotDerive: Whether the card has a Crew ability — no tap edges present, so any crew cost typical of Vehicles is simply absent from this data.
notes: Retest after adding the self registry. "Vehicle" subtype and base 4/4 P/T now correctly resolve — previously an accepted gap since nothing modeled a permanent's own subtype/P&T. Wording ("another," "in addition to its other types," the +1/+1 counter and until-end-of-turn duration) all still correct, no regression.
